FFmpeg version: 8.1.2
Target: arm64-apple-darwin
Compiler: /usr/bin/clang (Apple clang 21.0.0)
Resulting license: LGPL version 2.1 or later
GPL enabled: no
Nonfree enabled: no

Configure command:
./configure --prefix=<install-prefix> --arch=arm64 --target-os=darwin
--cc=/usr/bin/clang --enable-static --disable-shared --disable-debug
--disable-doc --disable-htmlpages --disable-manpages --disable-podpages
--disable-txtpages --disable-ffplay --disable-sdl2 --disable-libxcb
--disable-xlib --enable-pic --enable-videotoolbox --enable-audiotoolbox
--enable-securetransport

Enabled external libraries:
appkit avfoundation bzlib coreimage iconv securetransport zlib

Enabled Apple hardware acceleration:
audiotoolbox videotoolbox

Programs:
ffmpeg ffprobe

The resulting programs link only to macOS system libraries and frameworks.
See ffmpeg-macos-arm64.sh for the reproducible build procedure and
third_party/source_archives/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz for the exact source archive.
